ci_support_linux_64_c_compiler_version14:
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '14'
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
cuda_compiler:
- cuda-nvcc
cuda_compiler_version:
- '12.9'
cxx_compiler:
- gxx
cxx_compiler_version:
- '14'
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
numpy:
- '2'
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.11.* *_cpython
pytorch:
- '2.13'
target_platform:
- linux-64
zip_keys:
- - c_compiler_version
  - cxx_compiler_version
  - c_stdlib_version
  - cuda_compiler_version
name: mmcv
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: mmcv
  version: 2.2.0
  # see https://github.com/conda-forge/conda-forge.github.io/issues/1059 for naming discussion
  torch_proc_type: ${{ 'cuda' if cuda_compiler_version != 'None' else 'cpu' }}
  build_str_prefix: ${{ "cuda" ~ (cuda_compiler_version | version_to_buildstring) if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else "cpu_" }}

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmcv/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 13b2bdab6e97799177dee568efdb2ae0bb48b1dc924a8b617416ee8a392e5348
  patches:
    # conda-forge/mmengine installs the lighter upstream Python distribution.
    # Keep conda runtime deps on "mmengine", but make Python metadata pip-checkable.
    - use-mmengine-lite-metadata.patch
    - avoid-pkg-resources.patch
    # Python 3.13 no longer mutates optimized function locals through exec().
    # https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmengine/issues/1616#issuecomment-2559072367
    - fix-python313-version-loading.patch

build:
  number: 15
  string: ${{ build_str_prefix ~ "py" ~ (python | version_to_buildstring) ~ "h" ~ hash ~ "_" ~ build_number }}
  script:
    file: build_mmcv.sh
  skip:
    - win

requirements:
  build:
    - ninja
    - psutil
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    # this adds matching cuda requirement to run deps using __cuda package
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then: ${{ compiler('cuda') }}
  host:
    - numpy
    - packaging
    - pip
    - python
    - pytorch
    - pytorch * ${{ torch_proc_type }}*
    - setuptools
    - wheel
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then:
        # Ensure cuda version matches build https://github.com/conda-forge/mmcv-recipe-feedstock/issues/40
        - cuda-version ${{ cuda_compiler_version }}.*
        - libcublas-dev
        - libcusolver-dev
        - libcusparse-dev
  run:
    # intentionally skipping opencv and pytorch (following upstream vendor)
    # https://github.com/conda-forge/staged-recipes/pull/19400#discussion_r912546152
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then: cuda-version ${{ cuda_compiler_version }}.*
    - addict
    - mmengine >=0.3.0
    - packaging
    - Pillow
    - python
    - pyyaml
    - typing_extensions
    - yapf
  run_constraints:
    # additional run constraint to the one from the (version-only) run_export;
    # constraining the CPU builds to CPU pytorch isn't 100% necessary, but cleaner
    - pytorch * ${{ torch_proc_type }}*

tests:
  # - python:
  #     imports:
  #       - mmcv
  #     pip_check: true
  - files:
      source:
        - .dev_scripts/check_installation.py
        - tests
    requirements:
      run:
        - onnx
        - pip
        - pytest
        - pyturbojpeg
        - py-opencv >=4
        - tifffile
        - torchvision >=0.26
    script:
      # Manual import and pip checks to avoid py-opencv dep
      - python -c "import mmcv"
      - pip check
      - python ./.dev_scripts/check_installation.py
      - if: osx
        then:
          # unknown osx_64 and osx_arm64 segfault on test_pixel_group
          - $PYTHON -m pytest --verbose -rxXs -k "not test_pixel_group" ./tests/
        else:
          - $PYTHON -m pytest --verbose ./tests/
      - python -c "import mmcv; print(mmcv.__version__)"

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmcv
  summary: OpenMMLab Computer Vision Foundation
  license: Apache-2.0 AND LicenseRef-NVIDIA-License
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - LICENSES.md
  documentation: https://mmcv.readthedocs.io
  repository: https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmcv

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - apatsekin
    - das-intensity
    - weiji14
